node.statement: Index setup: a def-maincb-partition-state contains a nonempty current subset of its finite atomic index set J, hence J is nonempty. The displayed classes C_1,...,C_q partition J into nonempty equivalence classes, so q >= 1. For U_k=union_{a=1}^k C_a, each U_k is a nonempty union of whole classes; whenever k<q, U_k and C_{k+1} are disjoint nonempty unions sharing no class. Define the finite direct sum recursively by B^(1)=B_{C_1} and B^(k+1)=B^(k) oplus B_{C_{k+1}}; consequently U_q=union_a C_a and B^(q)=oplus_a B_{C_a}.
